headline: R&D payoff and high-end demand drive a profit surge
summary_short: Hangzhou Changchuan's H1 2026 preliminary net profit is guided to ¥900M–¥1.00B, up 111%–134% y/y, with Q2 EPS of ¥0.95 up 29.1% q/q and 90.0% y/y.
summary_long: H1 2026 net profit attributable is preliminarily guided to ¥900M–¥1.00B (+110.76% to +134.18% y/y); ex-non-recurring profit ¥855M–¥955M (+139.38% to +267.38% y/y). Q2 EPS of ¥0.95 rose 29.1% q/q and 90.0% y/y. Company attributes the surge to prior R&D investments now bearing fruit combined with strong high-end downstream demand, driving large sales gains across multiple product lines including digital testers, with scale effects amplifying the flow-through from revenue to profit. Figures are the company's own preliminary, unaudited forecast — the final half-year report was not located within budget.
confidence_notes: No edgarCik; shard sourceLink is a Yahoo fallback. Two WebSearch queries surfaced only the company's SZSE-mandated preliminary earnings forecast (业绩预告, published 2026-06-22), never the final audited half-year report. One WebFetch of the Securities Times (证券时报, stcn.com — non-aggregator) republish confirmed the main net-profit range and driver quote; the non-recurring-adjusted profit range came from the initial WebSearch snippet (中国基金报/chnfund.com, also non-aggregator) and was not independently re-fetched. All net-profit figures are preliminary ranges explicitly labeled unaudited. EPS row is the Q2-standalone actual from resolve-earnings-target.mjs's shard KPIs (Yahoo earningsChart) and is not on the same cumulative basis as the H1 profit range.

drivers.explanation: Prior R&D investments are now yielding results, combined with strong high-end downstream demand release; sales of digital testers and other product lines grew substantially, with scale effects amplifying profit growth.
